node_definition.done_when: Start from the reverted implementation: the first commit is git revert --no-edit 8f4d2afed3, which restores merge b3b1f5bcbb. Then implement the section's mechanism as the plan states it at b9eab5cda3. A review is composed only when the plan file is between ten minutes and a day old, no review is in flight, and a crew run on the plan (pointer node.plan or ledger plan field) is under a day old, under that run's session. Notes are answered only on reviews the pass composed, in one commit per pass. tests/test_a_plan_review_composes_itself.py shows every arm the section lists, with the two-days fixture carrying an hour-old run. Live-store arm in the gate log: a timed compose_owed_plan_reviews dry run on reckon and nova each returns within 30 s without raising, every plan it would compose has a run on it within the last day, and the reckon dry run lists a-queue-holds-the-whole-plan once that plan has been quiet ten minutes, as the positive control. The test files importing reckon.crew.plan_review or reckon.crew.resumption add no failures against the base revision. ruff check and ruff format --check pass on the changed paths.
